system.description:
A Stealth Strike that kills or knocks out its target doesn't alert other enemies, and you stay in Stealth. They may still find the body.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.41
system.summary: A Stealth Strike that kills or knocks out its target doesn't alert other enemies, and you stay in Stealth. They may still find the body.

automation.note: Use right after a Stealth Strike kills or knocks out its target: it restores the Stealth status the Strike removed, and other enemies stay unaware of you. Hidden bodies are the Director's call.
